name: Bounsweet
notes: Painted design (a mangosteen): magenta-purple rind (1, 6, 7) with a fine paper-like grain, a soft lighter highlight and a darker band at the bottom; white lower body (2) with the same grain and grey shading; a magenta star-shaped nub (3); pink feet (4, 5); green calyx sepals and the stem leaf (8-16), flat with a soft darker base and the same fine grain.

So: fruit rind = smooth, slightly waxy; only the painted grain as micro relief, a little more gloss. White body: grain only, matte. Sepals: thick waxy leaves, grain only, satin. No pores or bumps (none are painted). Nub and feet untouched.
Body shader 1542326572 and BodyA shader 534591824: no normal map is bound; in game only _dif and _par load; Body_nor is cache-only.
